verdict.rationale: ROS 2 docs describe generic middleware primitives (topics, services, actions, lifecycle nodes, CLI tools) but nowhere describe a human-intervention queue, failure-routing, or an operator handback workflow for teleoperation. Actions/lifecycle nodes could be building blocks for such a system, but there is no evidence ROS 2 itself ships this capability. Missing for 10: any documentation of an intervention-queue mechanism, failure-detection-to-human-handoff pattern, or operator control-handback workflow.
